text: SpotOn. Don't guess where to open. Ask the map.
You want to open a coffee shop near the station. Everyone says it's busy. But which corner? Who's already there? Is there even a shop to rent?
SpotOn counts what's really there. Every shop, every unit on the market, every stop, around every station in Jakarta.
Ask in your own words. The map lights up with the best spots for your business, and tells you why.
Open any area. See how busy it is, who you're up against, and what the space costs. Every number is real, never made up.
Then pick a real shop to rent, not a hexagon.
